# Enferno

> A web application built on Enferno: Flask 3, SQLAlchemy 2, Flask-Security and Vue 3 with Vuetify, no frontend build step. Replace this summary with what your application does.

Public pages need no login. The dashboard and admin API require a session; admin endpoints also require the `admin` role.

## Docs

- [Enferno documentation](https://docs.enferno.io/llms.txt): framework guides for authentication, development and deployment
- [Source code](https://github.com/level09/enferno): application code and the AGENTS.md guide for coding agents
